title: Two Google alumni raise $11.3M to back AI startups that enterprises will actually pay for
summary: BAG Ventures, founded by Google alumni, has closed a $11.3M Fund I focused on investing in enterprise-focused AI startups. The fund targets AI companies that can achieve commercial viability with paying enterprise customers.
content: BAG Ventures announces close of a $11.3M Fund I to invest in all things AI.

zh.title: 两名谷歌校友融资1130万美元投资企业用户真正愿意付费的AI初创公司
zh.summary: 由谷歌校友创办的BAG Ventures已完成其首期1130万美元基金的募集，专注于投资以企业为中心的AI初创公司。该基金的目标是投资那些能通过付费企业客户实现商业可行性的AI公司。

title: Airbnb adds AI search, more social features
summary: Airbnb is introducing AI-powered search capabilities alongside expanding service offerings including meal delivery and laundry in select locations. The expansion aims to position the platform as a broader lifestyle service provider beyond accommodation.
content: Airbnb is also launching new services such as meal delivery and laundry in select locations

zh.title: Airbnb推出AI搜索功能和更多社交特性
zh.summary: Airbnb正在推出AI驱动的搜索功能，同时在特定地点扩展其服务，包括送餐和洗衣服务。这次扩展旨在将该平台定位为超越住宿的更广泛的生活方式服务提供商。

title: Samsung gives its two-year-old Galaxy Tab S Plus an overhaul
summary: Samsung has released the Galaxy Tab S12 Plus, delivering a significant upgrade to the two-year-old Tab S10 Plus with a larger, brighter 12.6-inch display. The new lineup includes an Ultra model with minimal changes, while the regular Tab S12 is absent, likely arriving in 2027.
content:
The Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Ultra arrive together, with no regular Tab S12 in sight. | Image: Samsung	

Since the Galaxy Tab S10 line, Samsung has updated its flagship Ultra tablet annually, but alternates its regular and Plus variants. It means that this year's Galaxy Tab S12 series includes an Ultra model with few changes from last year's Tab S11 Ultra, and a Plus variant that brings a bigger overhaul to the two-year-old Tab S10 Plus. There's no regular Tab S12, suggesting fans of the smaller size will have to wait until 2027 for the next version of that tablet.

title: Samsung’s new SmartTag is smaller, longer-lasting, and works with iPhones
summary: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy SmartTag 3, a third-generation Bluetooth tracker with a smaller squircle design, improved battery life, and cross-platform iPhone support. The device features an IP67 rating but requires a protective case for key attachment, marking a design shift from previous models.
content:
Samsung has announced its third-generation Bluetooth tracker, the Galaxy SmartTag 3. It combines a smaller design and improved battery life with a few new tracking and software features, including cross-OS support intended to make it easier to share tracking information with friends and family.
As revealed by leaks, the SmartTag 3 has adopted a squircle design, similar to the original SmartTag but with one key difference: There's no cutout for a key ring. That means you'll have to buy one of Samsung's protective cases if you want to directly attach the tracker to keys or a carabiner. It has an IP67 rating for protection from the elements.

title: Cloudflare plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates
summary: Cloudflare announced plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates as part of a comprehensive overhaul of website authentication infrastructure. The move addresses emerging threats from quantum computing to current encryption standards.
content: The move will be part of a major overhaul of the ecosystem for website authentication.

zh.title: Cloudflare计划发行量子安全TLS证书
zh.summary: Cloudflare宣布计划作为网站身份验证基础设施全面改革的一部分发行量子安全TLS证书。此举旨在应对量子计算对现有加密标准带来的新兴威胁。

title: Apple’s ‘HomePad’ will reportedly launch on October 13th
summary: Apple will reportedly announce its long-rumored "HomePad" smart home hub on October 13th alongside new HomePod mini and Apple TV models, all showcasing Siri AI capabilities. The hub features a 6-inch wall-mountable or countertop display with iPhone-thin bezels.
content:
Apple's long-rumored smart home hub will reportedly be revealed on October 13th. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that the smart home device will be revealed alongside a new HomePod mini and an upgraded Apple TV device.
All three products are set to showcase Siri AI, Apple's overhauled AI-powered assistant. The smart home hub, a new product category for Apple, will be the centerpiece. It will reportedly feature a 6-inch display which can be mounted on a wall or sit on a countertop. The hub is "about as thick as an iPhone," according to Gurman, and has bezels similar to older iPads.

title: Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated the company will not pursue an IPO until it can make confident claims about model safety, with no timeline specified. He acknowledged that delaying too long would be harmful, highlighting the tension between ensuring safety and advancing AI progress.
content:
For months, people have wondered when OpenAI will go public. CEO Sam Altman says it won't happen until the company can make better promises about model safety, with no firm timeline in sight. "We intend to continue with AI progress … but as the models have had this surge forward in capability, and we see more of that ahead of us, we have got to be able to make confident safety claims," Altman said Tuesday during a Q&A with reporters after his DevDay keynote. At the same time, he said, waiting too long for an IPO would be "bad for the world."

zh.summary: OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 表示，在公司能够对模型安全做出有把握的声明之前，不会寻求 IPO，没有指定时间表。他承认延迟太久会造成伤害，强调了确保安全和推进 AI 进展之间的紧张关系。
